notes.title: 👤 Collectors Are In The Store!
notes.content:
[p]Hey hey!
If you see strangely dressed people wandering in front of your shop, don’t be surprised... because collectors are now in the store![/p][p]With the new update, we added 3 brand new systems to your shop. You can collect collectible items, open mysterious packs, and even bargain with crazy collectors![/p][p]💾 New Features
🧳 Traveler Pack System[/p][list][*][p]Interact with the "Traveler" character in front of your store and open mysterious collection packs.[/p][/*][*][p]With 3 different Tier options, Common to Legendary items await you.[/p][/*][*][p]Your hands might shake with excitement while opening packs — just saying![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601358/af402011bb8a8c61af6855c37cdec2f62b54a99c.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]📀 Collection System[/p][list][*][p]Now you can collect valuable collectible items that cannot be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Each has different rarity levels (Common, Rare, Legendary).[/p][/*][*][p]Collect them, display them in your showcase, and get ready to bargain![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601358/d5f83e8c0fb4e793061c9ebd26611ea27ed9de07.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]🤝 Bargaining with Collectors[/p][list][*][p]Collectors will come to your store wanting to buy and sell items with you.[/p][/*][*][p]Every collector has different patience, greed, and expertise.[/p][/*][*][p]Be persistent about the price, but beware... some aren’t very patient![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601358/26f807a33f2f6f4cc6e969b1d7e495850c602acc.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]🛒 From the Shop Owner’s Diary
“Today a collector came and tried to sell me the DVD of Half’s Live 2 for $1500. Are you kidding me?! But I accepted…”
– The drama of a shop owner.[/p][p]🎬 We’re dropping GIFs and screenshots below.
If you want to step into the world of collectors, add us to your wishlist![/p][p]🎮 DVD Store Simulator – Now Even More Collectible![/p]

notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX RELEASED: Critical Bug Fixes & Comfort Improvements!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Shop Owners![/b][/p][p]Thank you for your overwhelming interest and valuable feedback on our DVD Store Simulator demo! To make your demo experience even smoother and more enjoyable, we've just released a quick hotfix. This patch includes critical bug fixes that could break the game, gameplay balancing, and some important revisions for a more comfortable gaming experience.[/p][p]We've been working quickly to address these issues, some of which were identified through your feedback and others through our internal testing.[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue occurring when adjusting the FOV setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't save after acquiring lights.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where customer products at the cash register would not spawn correctly upon loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed products spawning at the cash register falling to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the FPS adjustment dropdown options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the POS system wouldn't accept single-digit numbers when taking payments.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where keyboard inputs wouldn't work on the POS system in some keyboard layouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a brightness issue with in-store lights during game save/load states.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements Made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the rate of trash spawning inside the shop, making cleaning more manageable.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction with the computer and cash register is now possible by clicking their screens, providing easier usability.[/p][/*][*][p]The duration of a day has been slowed down, allowing for more time within the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Open/Closed" sign outside the shop can now also be interacted with from inside.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are currently aware of and actively working on an issue where quitting the game takes a bit longer than expected in some situations. We aim to fix this in the next update.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is incredibly helpful in improving our game! Please continue to share your experiences and suggestions with us.[/p][p][b]Haven't tried the demo yet? Download it now on Steam and start building your dream DVD store![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773160/DVD_Store_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Don't forget to add our game to your Wishlist to be notified when the full version is released![/p][p][b]Happy gaming![/b][/p]

notes.title: DVD Store Simulator DEMO IS OUT NOW! Time to Build Your Dream Store!
notes.content: [p]Hello shop owners and simulation enthusiasts! The big moment has arrived! The long-awaited [b]DEMO of DVD Store Simulator[/b], which we have been working on for a long time and allows you to run your own DVD, figure, and tech product store, is now on STEAM! Are you ready to open your store's doors and climb from zero to the top?[/p][p][b]What’s in Store for You in the Demo?[/b][/p][p]With this special demo, you can take your first step into the DVD Store Simulator universe! Here are some of the fun features you’ll experience in the demo:[/p][p]* Licensed Product Sales: Purchase your first 3 licenses and start selling a variety of products in your store, from DVDs to tech gadgets and cool figures![/p][p] * Expand Your Store: Discover the first expansion options and start building your dream store.  [/p][p] * Decoration and Development: Personalize your store with brand-new shelves and eye-catching lighting from the hardware store, and impress your customers!  [/p][p] * Economic Risks: How about taking the plunge and borrowing money from the bank to play big? But be careful, random price changes and market surprises await you!  [/p][p] * Dynamic Pricing: Set the profit margin for your products yourself and try to make the most profitable sales!  [/p][p] * Customer Relations: Don't forget to keep your store clean! Customers can sometimes be messy, and the cleanliness of your store is critical to their satisfaction![/p][p][b]Why Should You Play the Demo?[/b][/p][p]This demo is a great opportunity to experience the unique simulation experience offered by DVD Store Simulator! While discovering the game's core mechanics, you'll dive into a relaxing and immersive business simulation. Additionally, we're participating in Steam Next Fest with this demo, so your support is more valuable to us than ever![/p][p][b]Your Feedback Is Very Valuable to Us![/b][/p][p]We need your input to make the full version of the game even better! Don't hesitate to share your thoughts, suggestions, and any issues you encounter after playing the demo.[/p][p][b]Join Our Community and Reach Out to Us:[/b][/p][p]* [url="https://discord.gg/SaWRSc7hnj"]Join Discord[/url]: Join our Discord server to communicate directly with developers, meet other players, and share your feedback![/p][p][b]Play the Demo Now and Add It to Your Wishlist![/b][/p][p]Start your journey to build your dream DVD store today! Download the demo, play it, and if you enjoy it, don’t forget to add DVD Store Simulator to your wishlist to be notified when the full version is released![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773160/DVD_Store_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DVD Store Simulator is officially part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
For the first time, you will be able to step into the shoes of a nostalgic shopkeeper and run your own DVD, figure and technology store.
Buy products, organize shelves, deal with customers and grow your store - all in a retro urban atmosphere.

🔸 What to Expect in the Demo:
[list]
[*] 3 product categories to manage (DVDs, Figures, Tech)
[*] Shelf management, pricing, and customer sales
[*] Customization props and light decoration
[*] Day-night cycle & store cleaning
[*] Sound, localization (EN + TR), and more!
[/list]
📝 Wishlist the game and get ready to open your doors on June 9.
Thanks for all your support — we can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: DVD Store Simulator has been officially announced! 🎉
notes.content:

We're excited to finally announce DVD Store Simulator – a cozy, retro-inspired shop management game where you run your own DVD and collectibles store!

🛍️ Buy DVDs and figurines
🧾 Set your prices
📦 Stock the shelves
💰 Sell to quirky customers
🏙️ Expand your store in a charming town with a full day-night cycle
